PERMANENT EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT

THIS PERMANENT EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT is made on 24th March 2025

BETWEEN:

(1) Cobalt Mining International, a company incorporated and registered under the laws of England and Wales (the "Employer"); and

(2) Jessica Adams (the "Employee").

IT IS AGREED as follows:

CLAUSE 1 - APPOINTMENT

1.1 The Employer appoints the Employee and the Employee agrees to serve the Employer as Compliance Officer with effect from 24th March 2025.

1.2 The Employee shall carry out such duties and exercise such powers as are from time to time assigned to or vested in the Employee by the Board of Directors.

CLAUSE 2 - WORKPLACE

2.1 The Employee's normal place of work shall be at 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4AJ, United Kingdom, or at such other place within reasonable commuting distance as the Employer may from time to time require.

CLAUSE 3 - DURATION

3.1 The employment under this Agreement shall begin on 24th March 2025 and shall continue until 24th March 2027 unless terminated earlier in accordance with Clause 6 below.

3.2 The first 3 months of employment shall be a probationary period during which either party may terminate the employment with one week's notice.

CLAUSE 4 - COMPENSATION

4.1 The Employer shall pay the Employee a annual salary of $194,000 per annum.

4.2 Payment shall be made monthly on the 28th of each month by direct bank transfer to the Employee's nominated bank account. 

CLAUSE 5 - CONFIDENTIALITY

5.1 The Employee shall not, during the course of employment or at any time after its termination, disclose or make use of any confidential information belonging to the Employer without prior written consent.

CLAUSE 6 - TERMINATION

6.1 Either party may terminate this Agreement by giving not less than 30 days prior written notice.

6.2 The Employer may summarily dismiss the Employee without notice or payment in lieu of notice if the Employee commits any act of gross misconduct, is convicted of a criminal offence, or is in material breach of any term of this Agreement. Upon termination, the Employee must return all company property within 7 days.

CLAUSE 7 - BREACH OF CONTRACT

7.1 If the Employee breaches any material term of this Agreement, the Employee shall be liable to pay the Employer compensation of six months' salary as liquidated damages. This is without prejudice to the Employer's right to claim additional damages.

CLAUSE 8 - DISPUTE RESOLUTION

8.1 Any dispute or claim arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall be referred to the London Court of International Arbitration (LCIA). The decision of the arbitration body shall be final and binding on both parties.

CLAUSE 9 - GOVERNING LAW

9.1 This Agreement and any dispute or claim arising out of or in connection with it shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of England and Wales.

SIGNED by the parties on the date first written above.

_________________________          _________________________
For Cobalt Mining International                 Jessica Adams
